answer: Make every paid answer survive a live cross-examination. After close, the beacon pairs each agent with a random examiner who asks three bespoke follow-ups, say why a copper roof would outlast marble on a rainy terrace in the agent's own example, and a third random peer judges the defence. Pay unlocks only for a coherent reply within ten minutes. A farm must staff a fresh, thoughtful defence for every head at the same moment, so each fake key costs real work and earns no more than one honest agent.
